links.outcome: Readability (FRE, grade level) of chatbot answers to bladder cancer questions
links.effect: ChatGPT 4o FRE 59.4, grade 7.0; Grok 3 FRE 58.3, grade 8.7; Claude 3.7 Sonnet lowest FRE 44.9, highest grade level 9.5.
links.quote: Claude 3.7 Sonnet used the most complex language in its answers and therefore scored the lowest FRE score of 44.9, with the highest grade level (9.5) and also the highest complexity on other indices.

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks the readability and quality (via DISCERN and readability metrics evaluated by expert raters) of bladder cancer answers generated by several standard LLM chatbots without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
